description: ONE CALL to offload work locally: pick the best model for a task on THIS machine, make it ready, and run it. Prefers models already loaded (no load cost), then installed models that fit your free VRAM, then (with allowPull) the best catalog model that fits. Task specialists (coder, vision, reasoning) win over general models; then larger fitting models win, grouped into size tiers (within ~20% parameter count); inside a tier, the model benchmarked fastest on this machine wins (run benchmark to record speeds; results expire after 14 days). Never uses a hosted provider unless allowHosted is true. Returns the completion plus a 'routing' block explaining the choice.

allowPull.description: Download a catalog model if nothing suitable is installed (default false)

contextLength.description: Context window to run with (Ollama num_ctx). Raise it for long inputs to avoid truncation.

messages.description: Chat messages; content may be a string or text/image parts (vision models)

provider.description: Restrict to one provider. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

schema.description: JSON Schema the output must satisfy

responseFormat.description: Constrain output to JSON (json_object) or a JSON Schema (json_schema); the result includes a validated 'parsed' value

stream.description: Stream tokens (default true). Progress notifications are sent when the client provides a progressToken.

task.description: What kind of work this is

name: delegate
title: Delegate a task to the best local model
